· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($150.41/$145.70) — above long-term, above long-term.

· RSI trajectory (41.7→38.7) + oversold diagnosis + continued downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (hist -0.4070→-0.4070) + holding steady diagnosis + absence of trend reversal signals.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $152.95) + band width at 3.51% indicating normal levels.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase) + consider buying on confirmation of 5-day low support.

analysis.patternNoteEn: The current price is continuing its accumulation phase, confirming support at the 5-day low. Trend reversal remains uncertain due to the lack of MACD improvement.
keyPoints: RSI가 과매도 구간에 진입하여 반등 가능성을 시사하나, MACD 히스토그램은 개선되지 않고 있다.
5일 저가인 $152.13 지지가 확인되었으며, 이는 20일 저가($152.13)와 동일하여 강력한 지지 구간을 형성한다.
거래량 비율이 1.44로 상승하여 현재 움직임에 대한 신뢰도를 높인다.
keyPointsEn: RSI has entered oversold territory, suggesting potential for a rebound, but the MACD histogram is not improving.
Support at the 5-day low of $152.13 is confirmed, matching the 20-day low ($152.13), forming a strong support zone.
The volume ratio of 1.44 indicates increased confidence in the current price movement.
